summary: Houston, ColdFusion developer, speaker at ColdFusion conferences, web development since 1999, manages a ColdFusion user group, strong interest in programming languages (Java, JavaScript, SQL), experienced with AWS, Linux, Windows/IIS, Ruby on Rails, Vagrant, WordPress development, has Cystic Fibrosis, married, considering children, strong opinions on tech industry practices, critical of outsourcing and low-cost development, engaged in discussions about social and political issues, active in online tech communities, prefers remote work, values personal integrity and professional growth.
